claim_ceiling: This work order freezes competing resolution mechanisms suggested by the observed failure surfaces. Even after evaluation it can establish only bounded structural feasibility or refutation on CA-3. It cannot establish a correct schema repair, legal rights, provenance truth, manifest admissibility, production readiness, or downstream authority.
evaluation_rule: Future evaluation may determine structural properties of each frozen hypothesis against the preserved Crosswalk 001 support surface. It may not declare any hypothesis correct, adopt a winner, mutate the manifest contract, rewrite evidence, or populate SOURCE_MANIFEST.csv.

provenance_evidence.proposal: Keep the singular manifest field and define a separately frozen rule selecting one sufficient provenance reference while preserving the full provenance set elsewhere.
Revise the manifest representation so provenance_evidence can preserve an ordered or typed collection of supporting references rather than collapsing multiple admissible references to one scalar.

provenance_status.proposal: Introduce an explicit provenance_status adjudication state verified|rejected|unverified, separate from capture or source workflow states.
Define a separately frozen projection from existing provenance-related states to verified|rejected|unverified only if equivalence is explicit.

redistribution_status.proposal: Introduce an explicit redistribution_status permitted|not_permitted|unknown independent of internal-use rights.
Define a separately frozen projection to redistribution_status only from evidence explicitly about redistribution permission; internal-use permission must not be promoted.

rights_basis.proposal: Introduce an explicit rights_basis classification using one of public_domain|open_license|permission|synthetic_owned|other_documented_basis, with evidence references kept separate.
Define a separately frozen projection from existing rights evidence vocabulary to a manifest rights_basis enum only where the underlying evidence explicitly supplies the classification premise.

rights_evidence.proposal: Keep the singular manifest field and define a separately frozen rule selecting one sufficient rights evidence reference while preserving the full evidence set elsewhere.
Revise the manifest representation so rights_evidence can preserve an ordered or typed collection of supporting references rather than collapsing multiple admissible references to one scalar.

rights_status.proposal: Introduce an explicit rights_status adjudication state verified|rejected|unverified rather than reusing workflow or reviewer states.
Define a separately frozen projection from existing rights disposition states to verified|rejected|unverified only if equivalence can be established without legal or semantic promotion.

source_kind.proposal: Introduce an explicit source_kind declaration at the bounded source metadata/admission layer using only the frozen manifest enum public|synthetic; do not derive it from acquisition/rendering roles.
Define a separately frozen deterministic projection from existing source metadata to public|synthetic, but only if every semantic premise is explicit and replayable.

source_locator.proposal: Introduce an explicit canonical source locator distinct from acquisition, landing-page, provenance, rights, and robots URLs.
Keep the singular manifest field but define a separately frozen role-based precedence rule that selects exactly one source-object locator and rejects non-source roles.

generalization_rule: CA-3 may support bounded feasibility/refutation of a mechanism on CA-3 only. It cannot establish cross-source generality. Any claim that a resolution mechanism is generally valid requires separately frozen held-out source validation.
